answer: Category 11 is marked Not disclosed. It covers emissions from washing and drying NIKE sold apparel and socks; footwear and equipment are assumed not to be washed. NIKE excluded it from SBT scope and FY24 disclosures because it will not form part of the restated science-based or 2030 enterprise Scope 3 target, reporting is optional for indirect use-phase emissions, no standardized footwear/accessories methodology exists, and apparel estimation methods vary substantially.
